title: How Is This So Cheap? - X-LAB GT8 Gravel Bike

takeaways.text: The borrowed size M, with 1×12 GRX Di2 (42T, 10–51T), Branta 45 mm carbon wheels and 45 mm Continental Terra Trail tyres set up tubeless, weighed 8.83 kg as shown.
One model at US$3,199 RRP at publication, with US sales tax extra by state; CADE found the electronic shifting and carbon wheels well ahead of similarly priced Canyon Grail or Specialized options.
X-LAB said 2026 international sales would run through country distributors and dealers as well as direct sales, with a two-year warranty on parts and a lifetime warranty on carbon framesets.
Finish was excellent: bolts threaded cleanly with no paint overspill. The demo bike lacked the down-tube storage bag, which X-LAB said comes with retail bikes.

Living with it: 55 mm tyre clearance, a round 27.2 mm seatpost for dropper options, an external seat clamp, extra bottle bosses and a separate bar and stem, but some internal routing, and proprietary headset spacers tie you to X-LAB's stem.

Six sizes, XS to XXL, with crank, stem and bar sizes scaling; the size M has 39 cm flared bars. Free swaps were planned only for premium road models, so GT8 buyers would order other sizes through dealers.

The size M suited the 5 ft 9½ in presenter and felt about the size of his small Scott gravel bike. The frame is compact with a sloping top tube, so he advises checking geometry charts or getting a fit first.

On a Park Tool DS-2 scale the 44 mm deep, 28 mm internal hooked wheels weighed 726 g front and 860 g rear and ran true with even spoke tension; the 170 mm power-meter crank weighed 839 g. The chain is SUMC, not Shimano.

disclosure: CADE Media borrowed the size M bike after XDS offered it and says it was not paid, did not keep the bike and XDS had no control over the video. The description names Garmin as a channel sponsor.
summary: An April 2026 first look at a borrowed size M X-LAB GT8 with 1×12 GRX Di2, Branta carbon wheels and 45 mm tyres, covering a weigh-in, measured wheel and crank weights, sizing, storage, warranty and the US price.
